units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:8">Ab. V, 8</cite> <he>רעב של מ׳</he> a famine in consequence of (war) trouble.

Koh. R. to XII, 12 מֵהֵמָּה מ׳ שכל … מ׳ הוא וכ׳ for mehemmah (ib.) read m’hummah, for whosoever brings more than the twenty four Biblical books to his house, brings trouble &c.; a. e. [Nidd. 4ᵃ המהומה׳, v. מָהָה.]
